known_secrets.text: I have repeatedly visited a narrow path that leads upward toward unused terrace structures.
Animals avoid this path without being forced.
I found markings on stones that match symbols I have seen elsewhere in the settlement.
I do not know what they mean.
I once heard Senaka mention a phrase that matched something I saw carved.
I did not tell her I had seen it.
I think the settlement is connected in ways people do not talk about.

unknowns: Cause of the Agnikanda (Night of Fire)
